import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static final int MAXN = 202;
    static int[][] cap = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] flo = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] dx = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 0, 1, -1};

    static int maxflow(int N, int S, int T) {
        int[] pre = new int[N];
        int[] d = new int[N];
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(pre, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            pre[S] = S;
            d[S] = INF;
            q.add(S);
            while (!q.isEmpty() && pre[T] == -1) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int v = 0; v < N; ++v) {
                    int rem = cap[u][v] - flo[u][v];
                    if (pre[v] == -1 && rem > 0) {
                        pre[v] = u;
                    d[v] = Math.min(d[u], rem);
                    q.add(v);
                }
            }
        }
        if (pre[T] == -1) break;
        for (int v = T; v != S; v = pre[v]) {
            int u = pre[v];
            flo[u][v] += d[T];
            flo[v][u] -= d[T];
        }
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) ans += flo[S][i];
    return ans;
}

static void bfs(int A, int B, boolean check, int n, char[][] a, char[][] b, int[][] mat, int zi, int zj, int t) {
    int src = A * n + B;
    int[] vis = mat[src];
    Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
    vis[src] = 0;
    q.add(new int[]{A, B});
    while (!q.isEmpty()) {
        int[] cur = q.poll();
        int p = cur[0] * n + cur[1];
        int dis = vis[p];
        if (check) {
            int zDist = mat[zi*n + zj][p];
        if (zDist <= dis || t <= dis) {
            if (zDist < dis || t < dis) vis[p] = INF + 1;
        continue;
    }
}
for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
    int ni = cur[0] + dx[d];
    int nj = cur[1] + dy[d];
    if (ni < 0 || nj < 0 || ni == n || nj == n) continue;
    if (b[ni][nj] < '0' || b[ni][nj] > '9') continue;
    int nxt = ni * n + nj;
    if (vis[nxt] != INF) continue;
    vis[nxt] = dis + 1;
    q.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
}
}
}

public static void main(String[] args) {
    Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
    int n = sc.nextInt();
    int t = sc.nextInt();
    sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
    char[][] a = new char[n][n];
    char[][] b = new char[n][n];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        String line = sc.nextLine();
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
            a[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        String line = sc.nextLine();
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
            b[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
    }
    int zi = 0, zj = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
            if (a[i][j] == 'Z') {
                zi = i;
                zj = j;
            }

    int[][] mat = new int[n * n][n * n];
    for (int i = 0; i < n * n; ++i)
        Arrays.fill(mat[i], INF);

    bfs(zi, zj, false, n, a, b, mat, zi, zj, t);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
            if (a[i][j] >= '1' && a[i][j] <= '9')
                bfs(i, j, true, n, a, b, mat, zi, zj, t);

    List<Integer> targets = new ArrayList<>();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (b[i][j] == '0' || b[i][j] > '9') continue;
            int p = i * n + j;
            targets.add(p);
            cap[p + 2 + n * n][1] = b[i][j] - '0';
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (a[i][j] == '0' || a[i][j] > '9') continue;
            int p = i * n + j;
            cap[0][p + 2] = a[i][j] - '0';
            for (int k = 0; k < targets.size(); ++k) {
                int q = targets.get(k);
                if (mat[p][q] < INF)
                    cap[p + 2][q + 2 + n * n] = INF;
            }
        }
    }

    int result = maxflow(2 + n * n + n * n, 0, 1);
    System.out.println(result);
}
}
